title.zh: v2.0.25 声学动态与音质增强：开闭镲物理阻尼互斥切音（Hi-Hat Choke Group）与底鼓对贝斯低频瞬态闪避（Sidechain Ducking）落地，实时与离线导出声学一致
title.en: v2.0.25 Acoustic dynamics & fidelity: Physical Hi-Hat Choke Group and Kick-Bass Low-End Sidechain Ducking implemented with live and export parity

highlights.zh: **Hi-Hat Choke Group 阻尼互斥切音**：遵循声学架子鼓镲片物理闭合特性与经典鼓机（TR-808/909）Exclusive Choke Group 机制，在 `AudioEngine` 与 `WavExporter` 中建立开闭镲联动状态。当闭镲（或 ratchet 滚奏）触发时，对处于振动衰减尾音的开镲施加 3ms 快速无爆音指数阻尼释音，彻底消除开闭镲重叠导致的脏乱高频混叠。
highlights.en: **Hi-Hat Choke Group**: Modeled after acoustic hi-hat pedal mechanics and Roland TR-808/909 exclusive choke groups. When a closed hi-hat or ratchet triggers, ringing open hi-hat voices are smoothly choked with a 3ms clickless exponential release ramp in both `AudioEngine` and `WavExporter`.

highlights.zh: **底鼓对贝斯低频闪避（Kick/Bass Sidechain Ducking）**：为解决 40–100Hz 次低频与超低频相位干涉和频率掩蔽难题，在通道条插入链与推子之间加入独立的 `duckGain` 动态闪避节点。每当底鼓音符触发时，贝斯通道自动按底鼓力度产生 ~-3dB 的精细瞬态下潜并在 65ms 内平滑恢复，显著提升整个混音底部的下潜凝聚力与瞬态打击感。
highlights.en: **Kick/Bass Low-End Sidechain Ducking**: Integrated a dedicated `duckGain` stage on channel strips before the volume fader. Triggering a kick transient dips bass channels by ~-3dB with an instant 3ms attack and smooth 65ms exponential release to resolve low-end frequency masking.

highlights.zh: **全流程离线导出对齐与单元验证**：离线渲染器 `WavExporter` 同步接入切音追踪与低频闪避算法，保证用户导出的 WAV 音频与浏览器实时监听具备 100% 的声学一致性，并通过新建的 `acousticEnhancements.test.ts` 严格断言。
highlights.en: **Full Export Parity & Test Suite**: The offline `WavExporter` implements identical choke group and sidechain ducking algorithms to maintain 100% acoustic parity with the live Web Audio engine, verified with new unit tests.
